predicted: C2 from HYPERGRAPH-COMPLEMENTARITY-PLAN.md. The `blend` policy that R76/R79 made this paper's recommendation interpolates local and merged with ONE lambda for every coordinate. A coordinate the target does not measure has no local estimate to shrink toward, so the scalar blend discounts partner-only variables by (1-lambda) against nothing at all -- at lambda=0.25 it discards three quarters of the only information anyone has about that coefficient. blend_cw applies lambda per coordinate, reading the schema hypergraph's incidence structure directly: lambda_j = lambda inside the target's hyperedge, 1 outside it. It adds NO parameter; lambda is still chosen on the same inner split by the same rule. PREDICTION: blend_cw beats blend on the pools with schema variation (eicu_sites, mimic4_sites, mimic_sites_unit_x_system) and the margin grows with d_extra, the count of merged coordinates the target cannot estimate -- that is the mechanism and the per-decision column exists to test it rather than assert it. R86 is why: complementary partners contribute mostly coordinates the target lacks, and those are exactly the ones the scalar blend discounts. C3 NEGATIVE CONTROL, and it is not optional: on acs_span_income every site measures every variable, d_extra is 0 on every decision, and blend_cw must equal blend EXACTLY -- verified to 5.5e-16 in a unit check already. If it differs there the effect is an implementation artefact and the whole result is void. KILL CONDITION: if blend_cw <= blend on mean AND on worst pool where schemas vary, C2 fails and the coordinate-wise route is closed. ATTRIBUTION: oracle_lambda_cw is reported alongside, so a blend_cw below blend with oracle_lambda_cw ABOVE oracle_lambda means the rule is right and the lambda selection is failing, which is a different repair from the rule being wrong. RERUN: the first pass FAILED its own C3 control -- 66 of 3,050 ACS decisions differed at the SAME lambda because `blend` round-trips through expit/logit and clips at +/-20.7 while _cw_logit returned the raw linear predictor. On large well-separated sites that difference was the clipping, not the rule. _cw_logit now round-trips identically. The first pass's numbers (eicu +0.00044 ns, mimic4 -0.0119) are superseded and must not be quoted.
